subject: Claude Messages API compact-on-demand beta, compact-2026-09-04
central_claim: Anthropic's September 14, 2026 Claude Messages API compact-on-demand beta is a publishable AI engineering topic because official release notes and compaction documentation support a bounded E2/R1 claim: long-running agent runtimes can request a server-generated signed compaction block in the background and replace older messages with it, changing context-management design from client-side summaries toward API-recognized history migration. The article does not claim independent improvements in model quality, latency or cost.

selection.reason: The September 14 feature changes how developers operate long-running Claude agents: background summary requests, signed compaction blocks, preserved recent turns, billing aggregation and failure handling affect runtime architecture and observability. Official release notes and API documentation give concrete behavior and limitations, while no benchmark or independent superiority claim is needed.

claims.claim: Claude Messages API compact-on-demand beta lets agent runtimes request a signed compaction block separately from a conversation turn and later replace older messages with it, which is an API-level context-management change rather than a verified model-performance improvement.
